question.explanation: A multiple of <math><mn>30</mn></math> must be a multiple of <math><mn>10</mn></math> and <math><mn>3</mn></math>. So the units digit is <math><mn>0</mn></math>, and the sum of digits must be a multiple of <math><mn>3</mn></math>. Using only digits 0 and 4, the least such number has three 4's (sum <math><mn>12</mn></math>) and one 0 at the end: <math><mn>4440</mn></math>.
question.question: What is the least positive integer multiple of 30 that can be written with only the digits 0 and 4?
